verdict.rationale: Supabase's own documentation offers self-hosting, deploying the stack "within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose." It positions this for users who "need full control over your data" or "have compliance requirements that prevent you from using managed services," so residency is in the user's hands through that route. Nothing in the pack shows a region or residency choice for managed hosted projects, so the story is only delivered by running your own deployment. Missing for 10: documented region selection at hosted-project creation, a data-residency or regional compliance commitment for the managed cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
